text:
alex (support): customer reported a sudden spike of 503s from hosted inference this morning, high QPS on model-x-3b

sara (sre): seeing same in prod metrics, error rate jump ~12:03 UTC, routing to fallback model kicked in :alarm_clock:

ryan (oncall): I'm looking at the worker nodes now. Observed frequent container restarts on a subset of gpus in zone-us-west-2a

jia (runtime): any signs in dmesg or nvcrash logs? could be GPU OOM or illegal instruction

alex (support): customer says 503s started after a large fine-tune job hit the fleet. They tried again with smaller batch but still 503s

ryan (oncall): pulled recent launcher logs, snippet: ```
2026-04-12T12:03:15Z worker[pid=421]: segfault at 0 ip 0x7f2e0f2e msg="signal 11"
2026-04-12T12:03:15Z cgexec: killing process 421 (oom-kill)
2026-04-12T12:03:20Z container restart
```

jia (runtime): that looks like a SIGSEGV followed by OOM-kill. Could be KV prefetch memory regression or attention kernel bug after model swap

sara (sre): I repro'd a crash locally when enabling aggressive prefetch + batch-size 8 on that model. Repro steps: 
1) pull model-x-3b:v12
2) start runner with PREFETCH=true KV_PREFETCH=1
3) send ~80 concurrent requests with seq_len=2048 and batch_size=8

alex (support): customer gave these headers: `prompt-size=1800, streaming=false, max_tokens=1024` and they hit sudden latency then 503s

jia (runtime): temporary mitigation: disable KV prefetch and reduce batch_size to 1 or 2 on affected pools. Also pin model to v11 (we suspect v12 introduced kernel change)

ryan (oncall): rolling restart on pool-a with patched runtime flags (KV_PREFETCH=0) started. I'll divert traffic to fallback region while we validate :inbox_tray:

deploy-bot: started canary roll: runner-config-update on pool-a (3/60)

alex (support): notified customer that we're applying mitigation and will follow up once stable. They requested repro checklist for their engineering team

jia (runtime): jotting repro checklist for them: 
- use model-x-3b:v12 (or v11 for comparison)
- seq_len >= 1500 to stress KV paths
- enable concurrent qps >= 60
- set PREFETCH=1 to reproduce crash faster
- capture `/var/log/runner.log` + `dmesg` + `nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps` on crash

sara (sre): long-term: we should add an automated regression test in CI that runs model-swap + prefetch stress with lower-cost GPU to catch kernel regressions before rollout

ryan (oncall): pool-a stabilization looks good after disabling prefetch. error rate down to baseline. I'll keep oncall for 2 hours and then handoff

alex (support): customer very appreciative of quick triage. I'll send them the repro checklist and note the temporary mitigations. Opening a follow-up ticket with runtime team to root-cause v12 change

jiA (note): runtime to create postmortem if we determine code change in v12 caused kernel path to allocate unbounded GPU memory

ci-bot: created issue #RT-2187 "model-x-3b v12: KV prefetch memory regression" assigned to jia

sara (sre): action items: 
- jia: investigate kernel change in v12, reproduce on bench and produce minimal repro
- runtime: add CI stress test for prefetch + model swap (RT-2187)
- oncall: monitor pools and revert v12 from rolling updates until fixed

alex (support): closing the customer escalations loop once we confirm fix. Will update CS channel and paste postmortem draft when available :thumbsup:
